objects.text: This area will contain the washing machine, dryer and possibly the fridge, as I don't know if it will fit in the kitchen design yet. For the floor I am thinking of having the same floor as the kitchen (probably tiles? Vinyl? Something easily cleanable)

blocks.s: Floor and Wall

I like the tiles and grouting in this bathroom, but my problem is that I don’t have a window, I have a big led panel of 100x20cm that is supposed to be quite bright. Also I have this classical granito floor that I intend to keep and polish to shine
Something like this is what the floor looks like:

data:image/jpeg;base64,

As for the sink I am going to pour concrete, and I would like wood drawers underneath, sort of looking like these. Also the divider made of the glass bricks is something I really like, but I’m not sure if we have space. The wall tile color is also quite good here
https://www.instagram.com/p/DcTw8Mro6A2/?igsi=MTcxODgyZzV3cTVjYQ%3D%3D
Piping

One more thing to note about the bathroom, the pipes are all in front of the wall currently, I might add them to the floor plan as well. The 2 walls perpendicular to the load bearing walls are not load bearing, and I think I can open them up and guide most of the piping through there, so I can move the shower to a different wall in a nice way. The drain however is fixed in position, I cannot change that
Direction door opening
Also the door opens to the inside now, but I think we can also change that so we can utilize the space inside the room better as opposed to the hallway.

blocks.s: Kitchen
Things I have sort of decided on already:
- The fronts of the cupboards will be homemade. Basically a multiplex board with a hole for the handle.
- The worktop will be poured concrete. Possibly also the sink.
- I'll have a gas stove of 90cm wide (quite big)
Things I need help with:
- color of the window side
- Tiles for the backsplash. Definitely tiles, my first idea was white tiles and colored grout, but I am open to anything that fits the vibe of the things I already have.
- Floor. Something easily cleanabe. I thought of concrete look tiles or PVC, but that would be a lot of concrete a the worktop is also concrete
- The layout and what walls to remove. The wall between kitchen and living room goes for sure. The wall that creates the entry hall I think too, but not sure.
